question: Which woman football player won 'Ballon d'Or Award 2019'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Megan Rapinoe**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Megan Rapinoe** is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger and captains OL Reign in the National Women's Soccer League (NWSL).
 
• She won the **Ballon d'Or Féminin in 2019**, which is awarded to the best female footballer in the world.
 
• Rapinoe is known for her exceptional skill, leadership on the field, and her advocacy for social justice issues.
 
• In 2019, she also won the **Golden Boot** and the **Golden Ball** at the FIFA Women's World Cup, where she helped lead the United States to victory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ballon d'Or Féminin**

 
 
• The Ballon d'Or Féminin is an annual football award presented by France Football.
 
• It honors the best female footballer in the world and was first awarded in 2018.
 
• The award is part of the Ballon d'Or awards, which also include the Ballon d'Or for the best male footballer.
 
• It is considered one of the most prestigious individual awards in women's football.
 
 
 
• **Golden Boot**
 
 
• The Golden Boot is awarded to the top goalscorer of a tournament or league.
 
• At the FIFA Women's World Cup, it is given to the player who scores the most goals during the tournament.
 
• If there is a tie, the award goes to the player with the most assists.
 
 
 
• **Golden Ball**
 
 
• The Golden Ball is awarded to the best player of a tournament, as voted by journalists, coaches, and team captains.
 
• At the FIFA Women's World Cup, it recognizes the most outstanding player throughout the competition.
 
 
 
• **Megan Rapinoe's Advocacy**
 
 
• Rapinoe is well-known for her activism and advocacy for equal pay, LGBTQ+ rights, and racial justice.
 
• She has used her platform to speak out against discrimination and has been a vocal advocate for gender equality in sports.
 
• Rapinoe's influence extends beyond the football field, making her a significant figure in both sports and social justice movements.
